to live is to walk brief jornada,
and death viva is, Lico, nuestra life,
ayer al frágil body amanecida,
cada instante in the body sepultada.


Nada, that siendo, is poco, and será nada
in poco time, that ambiciosa olvida;
pues of the vanidad mal persuadida,
anhela duración, earth animada.


Llevada of engañoso thought,
and of hope burladora and ciega,
tropezará in the mismo monumento.


as the that divertido the sea navega,
and without moverse vuela with the wind,
and antes that piense in acercarse, llega.
